RSS Chief Links Fragility in Children to Screen Time and Family Guidance

Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat has stated that children are becoming more mentally fragile due to a lack of family guidance and excessive screen time. He highlighted these factors as contributing to the perceived fragility in the younger generation. This statement offers a perspective on societal influences affecting children's well-being.
